questions.question: New recipe on the Planner screen needs a cookbook before the form can fill in (title, servings, cuisine, note, source, per-book limit). How should the cook pick one?

options.label: Cookbook field in form (Recommended)
options.description: One 'New recipe' dialog with a Cookbook picker as the first field. The other fields show once a book is picked and fill in from it. Reuses the existing form unchanged below the new field. Fast to use.

questions.question: Which cookbooks should the Cookbook picker on the Planner screens offer?

options.label: All public books (Recommended)
options.description: Every public cookbook the cook can see, searched by the server, with no drafts and no templates. Same rule as the book page, which doesn't restrict by status, so no new rule is invented.

options.label: Saved books only
options.description: Hides unsaved and archived books. A shorter list, but a new rule the book page doesn't have: an archived book could get a recipe from its page but not from the list.

questions.question: When the cook picks a cookbook that's already at its plan's per-book recipe limit (50), what happens now?

options.label: Pick, then grey Save (Recommended)
options.description: The book can be picked; the form reads its count and greys Save with 'Recipe limit reached' plus Upgrade / Contact owner, the same as the book page. No extra reads per row.

options.label: Hide full books in the list
options.description: Books at the limit show greyed in the list. This needs a recipe count for every row in the list, so many extra reads, and the API has no count filter for it.

questions.question: If the cook has typed into the form and later changes the Cookbook, what happens to what they typed?

options.label: Re-fill everything (Recommended)
options.description: The form starts over from the new book: title, servings, cuisine, note and source all come from it. Simple and predictable, since every field depends on the book, but typed text is lost.

options.label: Keep typed title and note
options.description: Only fields the cook hasn't touched re-fill. Keeps work, but a title like 'Lemon pasta (1)' can end up in a different book, with a suffix that's now wrong.
